name: Rusty Shiv survives the hits it accumulates and pays out at expiry (#10767)
contract: Rusty Shiv 561315 reads "Stab an enemy with a rusty shiv, accumulating 20% of all damage you deal to them over the next
duration and dealing damage at the end of the duration for the total amount." Its aura script (accumulate, then pay
681459 at expiry) refuses to attach unless the spell's effect 1 has been reshaped from a school absorb into a dummy and
SPELL_ATTR3_DOT_STACKING_RULE is set. The load-time contract only reshaped the effect when MiscValueB was 10, and the
current Spell.dbc carries 20, so the script never attached: effect 1 stayed an absorb of zero, which the first hit
removed, and the Ranger saw the shiv vanish the moment Wild Strike landed with nothing paid. A level 40 Ranger in
stealth with a dagger stabs a dummy with Rusty Shiv, then hits it with Wild Strike 501724: the aura must outlast the
hit, and when it expires the target must have taken the accumulated damage from Rusty Shiv Damage 681459.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Rusty Shiv is on the dummy
Land Wild Strike on the stabbed dummy
DISCRIMINATING: Rusty Shiv outlasts the hit it accumulates
Nothing is paid before the shiv expires
DISCRIMINATING: expiry paid the accumulated damage
